components.label: None (manual / live-scored)
components.description: No playable component. Scores are entered by an admin or judge.

components.label: Quiz (multiple choice)
components.description: A timed or untimed multiple-choice quiz. Each question awards points; the total is the max score.

components.label: Real or Fake (Wikipedia titles)
components.description: 10 article titles, 10 seconds each. Decide real or fake. Speed breaks ties.

_howToAdd: When you build a playable game component in components/games/, register it here: add an object with a unique 'key' (e.g. 'quiz-v1'), a human 'label' shown in the admin dropdown, a short 'description', and a 'defaultMaxScore'. Then map the key to the actual component in components/games/registry.tsx. The admin game form reads this file to populate the component dropdown; the games table stores the chosen key in component_key.
